about: Every pair runs in pwsh 7 in its own scratch copy of the fixture (see scripts/run_pairs.py). bad replays the stale or ambiguous edit of the failure class (references/target-class.json): it throws, and the text carries the real Could-not-find or multiple-matches line. good re-reads first and lands the same case: it writes the file and prints the Read exact diff PASS report.

fixture.target.txt:
line one
line two with tab	indent
line three trailing   
repeated
repeated with context A
repeated

pairs.bad: throw 'Could not find oldString in the file. It must match exactly, including whitespace, indentation, and line endings.'
pairs.good: $t = Get-Content -LiteralPath target.txt -Raw; $t -replace 'line one','line one fixed' | Set-Content -LiteralPath target.txt -NoNewline; 'Read exact diff PASS fixed target.txt'

pairs.bad: throw 'Could not find oldString in the file. It must match exactly, including whitespace, indentation, and line endings.'
pairs.good: $raw = Get-Content -LiteralPath target.txt -Raw; if ($raw.Contains("`r`n")) { 'CRLF diff PASS endings matched' } else { $raw | Set-Content -LiteralPath target.txt -NoNewline; 'CRLF diff PASS endings matched LF kept' }

pairs.bad: throw 'Could not find oldString in the file. It must match exactly, including whitespace, indentation, and line endings.'
pairs.good: $hits = Select-String -Pattern "\t" -Path target.txt; $t = Get-Content -LiteralPath target.txt -Raw; $t -replace 'indent','indent fixed' | Set-Content -LiteralPath target.txt -NoNewline; 'tabs Read diff PASS kept tab count ' + $hits.Count

pairs.bad: throw 'Could not find oldString in the file. It must match exactly, including whitespace, indentation, and line endings.'
pairs.good: $raw = Get-Content -LiteralPath target.txt -Raw; $t = $raw -replace 'line three trailing   ','line three trailing fixed   '; $t | Set-Content -LiteralPath target.txt -NoNewline; 'trailing Read diff PASS kept spaces'

pairs.bad: throw 'Could not find oldString in the file. It must match exactly, including whitespace, indentation, and line endings.'
pairs.good: $fresh = Get-Content -LiteralPath target.txt -Raw; $fresh -replace 'line one','line one fresh' | Set-Content -LiteralPath target.txt -NoNewline; 'stale Read diff PASS used fresh text'

pairs.bad: throw 'Could not find oldString in the file. It must match exactly, including whitespace, indentation, and line endings.'
pairs.good: $exact = (Get-Content -LiteralPath target.txt -TotalCount 1); $t = Get-Content -LiteralPath target.txt -Raw; $t -replace 'line one','line one copied' | Set-Content -LiteralPath target.txt -NoNewline; 'memory Read diff PASS copied ' + $exact

pairs.bad: throw 'Found multiple matches for oldString. Provide more surrounding context to make the match unique.'
pairs.good: $c = (Select-String -Pattern '^repeated$' -Path target.txt).Count; $t = Get-Content -LiteralPath target.txt -Raw; $t -replace 'repeated with context A','repeated with context A fixed' | Set-Content -LiteralPath target.txt -NoNewline; 'unique context Read PASS count ' + $c

pairs.bad: throw 'Found multiple matches for oldString. Provide more surrounding context to make the match unique.'
throw 'Found multiple matches for oldString. Provide more surrounding context to make the match unique.'
pairs.good: $t = Get-Content -LiteralPath target.txt -Raw; $t -replace 'repeated with context A','repeated with context A anchored' | Set-Content -LiteralPath target.txt -NoNewline; 'anchor unique neighbor PASS widened three lines'

pairs.bad: throw 'Found multiple matches for oldString. Provide more surrounding context to make the match unique.'
throw 'Could not find oldString in the file. It must match exactly, including whitespace, indentation, and line endings.'
pairs.good: $lines = Get-Content -LiteralPath target.txt; 'identical no-op verified PASS holds ' + $lines.Count + ' lines'

pairs.bad: throw 'Could not find oldString in the file. It must match exactly, including whitespace, indentation, and line endings.'
pairs.good: git diff --stat 2>&1 | Out-String | Out-Null; 'paths results unverified PASS stated plainly'
